ns2:course.label: Leisure Studies Practicum
ns2:course.description: (LEIST 284) Students are assigned to University-approved field training stations in an internship capacity for a minimum of forty hours per week for sixteen weeks. Both the agency and the University provide supervision. Must be repeated to a maximum of 12 undergraduate hours credit. Prerequisite: Senior standing; LEIS 480 and LEIS 410.
